build_polyfaiss_wrapper: build a RagDropoutPolyWrapper from an Opt config to use as a RAG query encoder
build_polyencoder_model: build a poly-encoder module by calling RagDropoutPolyWrapper._build_model with Parlai options
encode_query_vectors: encode query token vectors into embeddings using RagDropoutPolyWrapper.forward with a LongTensor
get_embedding_size: get the embedding size of the context encoder via RagDropoutPolyWrapper.embedding_size property
review_reduce_ctxt: review the reduce_ctxt function from dropout_poly used to reduce context representations by reduction type
